content: The two-dimensional visualization of an example word npAl is shown in FIGREF14. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) technique was used to generate this visualization which helps use to analyze the nearest neighbor words of a given sample word. 84 and 104 nearest neighbors were observed using word2vec and fasttext embedding respectively on the same corpus.
